title: Claude MCP order help
author: TastyTrading
selftext:
Hey folks, I recently setup claude MCP connector in my claude max subscription to trade with a toy robinhood account here for kicks. I call it my "trading battle bot", its honestly hella addictive now that I have started this journey.

Anyways, Im 1 week in but im trying to figure out how you all do you "stop loss" type orders on your agentic bots?

From what ive learned: you can't currently set a true "trail stop loss" order as I normaly do in thinkorswim on schwab brokaerage. I think robinhood has these though but not supported for agentic trading yet because its in BETA still. this was released recently I believe.

My hacky solution: I have a tight loop that look at prices and if it goes up, i then cancel my stop loss and just move it up maually. this results in lots of tiny place/cancel orders on the stop loss as price goes in my favor. Is this a reasonable solution yall think or can it be improved?

Would love to hear what type of bots you all are building and wether they are math based or sentiment/emotion based and how you feed it data!
